_comment: GgufProvider settings (src/refactor_ai/providers/gguf.py) for the project review mode (docs/architecture/project-review.md): a 4-bit GGUF model served by llama.cpp. Copy to configs/model.project.local.json, which Git ignores. Relative paths resolve against this file's directory. Keys starting with an underscore are comments.
_python: Training-environment interpreter with llama-cpp-python installed (training/requirements-llm.txt); on Linux use ../.venv-train/bin/python.
_model_dir: Folder holding the GGUF file, downloaded at exactly model_revision with training/download_model.py --include (see its docstring).
_context_tokens: llama.cpp context window: prompt plus generated tokens.
_gpu_layers: -1 puts every layer on the GPU; lower it if the GPU runs out of memory.
